business_summary: Awa Paper & Technological Company, Inc. manufactures and sells functional papers and non-woven fabrics in Japan, Thailand, China, rest of Asia, the United States, and internationally. The company offers automotive filter papers, clutch plate friction papers, membrane support fabrics, and battery separator papers; m-fine submerged membrane for membrane bio-reactor products, which include modules, units, wastewater treatment system packages, and microbial solutions, as well as after-sales services consisting of remote monitoring and maintenance; thermal management materials comprising M-thermo high thermal conductive, M-thermo heat conductive, and M-thermo thermal insulation materials; carbon composite materials consisting of carbon and activated carbon fiber sheets, activated carbon sheets, carbon fiber reinforced plastics, and graphite sheets; synthetic fiber papers, including polyester and polyolefin sheets; and air, oil, fuel, and nano coat filter media, as well as filter media for brewery, dry cleaning, and electronic discharge machining. It also provides inorganic powder paper comprising base papers for gaskets and meerschaum sheets; air conditioning management materials consisting of base papers for humidifiers and dehumidifiers; high performance fiber paper, including aramid sheets; and low-density thick paper products, such as cushion and impregnated papers. In addition, the company offers engine filter media; food grade paper; and functional paper for electrical and electronic components products. Its products are used in various applications, such as liquid processing, gas processing, engines, automobiles, industrial, information and communication, building materials, air conditioning, home electronics, agricultural use, and general consumer goods. Awa Paper & Technological Company, Inc. was founded in 1916 and is headquartered in Tokushima, Japan.
business_summary_ko: Awa Paper & Technological Company, Inc.는 일본, 태국, 중국, 기타 아시아 지역, 미국 및 국제적으로 기능성 종이와 부직포를 제조 및 판매합니다. 이 회사는 자동차 여과지, 클러치 플레이트 마찰지, 멤브레인 지지 직물 및 배터리 분리 용지를 제공합니다. 모듈, 유닛, 폐수 처리 시스템 패키지, 미생물 솔루션을 포함하는 막 생물 반응기 제품용 m-fine 침지형 막과 원격 모니터링 및 유지 보수로 구성된 애프터 서비스; M-열고열전도재, M-열전도재, M-열단열재로 구성된 열관리 소재; 탄소 및 활성탄소섬유시트, 활성탄시트, 탄소섬유강화플라스틱, 흑연시트로 이루어진 탄소복합재료; 폴리에스테르 및 폴리올레핀 시트를 포함하는 합성 섬유 종이; 공기, 오일, 연료 및 나노 코팅 필터 매체뿐만 아니라 양조장, 드라이클리닝 및 전자 방전 가공용 필터 매체도 포함됩니다. 또한 개스킷용 원지 및 해포석 시트를 포함하는 무기분체지; 에어컨 관리재료로 구성되어 있습니다.
